decision: Retain preference-v4 as a promising experimental selector relative to auditory-v1 on this shared search pool; reproduction quality remains poor and it is not promoted to the CLI default. All displayed candidates remain below 4/5 likeness. Preserve all labels; usefulness is not likeness. Prioritize event structure, texture and unwanted-click diagnostics over further brute-force expansion alone.
nextExperiment: Use preference-v4 as the incumbent experimental comparator. Test event-order/gap and texture-modulation representations separately, plus reference-aware unwanted-click diagnostics. Validate on grouped reference families where possible; retain ties and repeated-session judgments. Do not apply a blanket transient penalty to impacts or clicks.
